rationale: python -m figtree animate output, untouched. The pulse tokens are <circle r=3> with no cx/cy (they are positioned by offset-path at runtime), so the static critic sees three circles at (-3,-3) and reports two critical overflows: a 10.0 figure scores 8.83 after animation. Fix: give tokens their path-start cx/cy with transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center (what the other probes here do), or exclude data-role=pulse from the content bbox.
